verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה׀ שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־ תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh šə·ma‘ tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî be·’ĕ·mu·nā·ṯə·ḵā ha·’ă·zî·nāh ’el- ta·ḥă·nū·nay bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā ‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: A Psalm of David O LORD hear my prayer In Your faithfulness give ear to my plea in Your righteousness answer me

verses.original: וְאַל־ תָּב֣וֹא עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ חָֽי׃ יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כָל־
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tā·ḇō·w ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ḇə·miš·pāṭ ’eṯ- kî lō- ḥāy yiṣ·daq lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ḵāl
verses.literal: Do not bring Your servant into judgment . . . for no one alive is righteous before You . . .

verses.original: כִּ֥י אוֹיֵ֨ב׀ רָ֘דַ֤ף נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א חַיָּתִ֑י לָ֭אָרֶץ הוֹשִׁיבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים עוֹלָֽם׃ כְּמֵתֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: kî ’ō·w·yêḇ rā·ḏap̄ nap̄·šî dik·kā ḥay·yā·ṯî lā·’ā·reṣ hō·wō·šî·ḇa·nî ḇə·ma·ḥă·šak·kîm ‘ō·w·lām kə·mê·ṯê
verses.literal: For the enemy has pursued my soul crushing my life to the ground making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead

verses.original: רוּחִ֑י וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י לִבִּֽי׃ יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י
verses.literal: My spirit grows faint within me my heart is dismayed inside me

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים׀ מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־ פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵar·tî yā·mîm miq·qe·ḏem hā·ḡî·ṯî ḇə·ḵāl- pā·‘o·le·ḵā ’ă·śō·w·ḥê·aḥ bə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: I remember the days of old I meditate on all Your works I consider the work of Your hands

verses.original: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י׀ עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ כְּאֶֽרֶץ־ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: pê·raś·tî yā·ḏay ’ê·le·ḵā nap̄·šî ‘ă·yê·p̄āh lə·ḵā kə·’e·reṣ- se·lāh
verses.literal: I stretch out my hands to You my soul thirsts for You like a parched land Selah

verses.original: עֲנֵ֨נִי׀ מַ֘הֵ֤ר יְהוָה֮ ר֫וּחִ֥י כָּלְתָ֪ה אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־ יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nê·nî ma·hêr Yah·weh rū·ḥî kā·lə·ṯāh ’al- tas·têr pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî wə·nim·šal·tî ‘im- yō·rə·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Answer me quickly O LORD my spirit fails Do not hide Your face from me or I will be like those . . . who descend to the Pit

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי חַסְדֶּךָ֮ בַבֹּ֨קֶר׀ כִּֽי־ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי בְךָ֪ הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אֵ֝לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: haš·mî·‘ê·nî ḥas·de·ḵā ḇab·bō·qer kî- ḇā·ṭā·ḥə·tî ḇə·ḵā hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî de·reḵ- zū ’ê·lêḵ kî- ’ê·le·ḵā nā·śā·ṯî nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning for I have put my trust in You Teach me the way - I should walk for to You I lift up my soul
Deliver me from my enemies O LORD I flee to You for refuge

verses.original: לַמְּדֵ֤נִי׀ לַֽעֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י טוֹבָ֑ה רוּחֲךָ֥ תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי מִישֽׁוֹר׃ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ
verses.transliteration: lam·mə·ḏê·nî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ rə·ṣō·w·ne·ḵā kî- ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·w·hāy ṭō·w·ḇāh rū·ḥă·ḵā tan·ḥê·nî mî·šō·wr bə·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: Teach me to do Your will for You are my God May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן־ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓׀ תוֹצִ֖יא נַפְשִֽׁי׃ מִצָּרָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an- šim·ḵā Yah·weh tə·ḥay·yê·nî bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ṯō·w·ṣî nap̄·šî miṣ·ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: For the sake of Your name O LORD revive me In Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble

verses.original: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־ צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḥas·də·ḵā taṣ·mîṯ ’ō·yə·ḇāy wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tā kāl- ṣō·ră·rê nap̄·šî kî ’ă·nî ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And in Your loving devotion cut off my enemies Destroy all who afflict me for I am Your servant
